quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用 must / might / can't + have + V3 对过去的情况做推断。

helpMemoryTips.title: 过去推断
helpMemoryTips.text: must have + V3（一定做过）、might have + V3（可能做过）、can't have + V3（不可能做过）。

quizzes.title: 听力：A news report
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。新闻里有被动和过去推断结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: 被动 + 过去推断
helpMemoryTips.text: have been forced（被动完成）；must have been the heaviest（过去推断）。

quizzes.readingPassage: Good evening. Here is the news. Heavy rain has caused flooding in several parts of the country today. In the north, hundreds of people have been forced to leave their homes. The government has promised to send help, and emergency teams are working through the night. Experts say the rain must have been the heaviest in fifty years. Drivers are advised to avoid the affected roads. We will bring you more updates later this evening.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 晚上好，为您播报新闻。今天暴雨在全国多地引发洪灾。北方有数百人被迫离开家园。政府已承诺派遣救援，应急队伍正连夜工作。专家称这场雨可能是五十年来最大的一次。提醒驾驶员避开受灾路段。今晚稍后我们将带来更多最新消息。

readingQuestions.question: What are drivers advised to do?

quizzes.title: 非限定性定语从句

subjects.display: 我叔叔（住在伦敦）是医生。
这本书（去年出版）很受欢迎。
她哥哥（一名教师）帮了我们。
这部电影（我上周看的）很棒。

sentences.sentence: 我叔叔（住在伦敦）是医生。 → My uncle, ____ lives in London, is a doctor.
sentences.english: 我叔叔（住在伦敦）是医生。
sentences.referenceExample: My uncle, **who** lives in London, is a doctor.

sentences.sentence: 这本书（去年出版）很受欢迎。 → The book, ____ was published last year, is popular.
sentences.english: 这本书（去年出版）很受欢迎。
sentences.referenceExample: The book, **which** was published last year, is popular.

sentences.sentence: 北京（中国的首都）很大。 → Beijing, ____ is the capital of China, is huge.
sentences.referenceExample: Beijing, **which** is the capital of China, is huge.

sentences.sentence: 她哥哥（一名教师）帮了我们。 → Her brother, ____ is a teacher, helped us.
sentences.english: 她哥哥（一名教师）帮了我们。
sentences.referenceExample: Her brother, **who** is a teacher, helped us.

sentences.sentence: 这部电影（我上周看的）很棒。 → The film, ____ I saw last week, was great.
sentences.english: 这部电影（我上周看的）很棒。
sentences.referenceExample: The film, **which** I saw last week, was great.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 非限定从句用逗号隔开，补充「额外」信息（去掉也不影响主句意思），不用 that。

helpMemoryTips.title: 逗号 + who/which
helpMemoryTips.text: My uncle, **who** lives in London, is a doctor。人用 who，物用 which，绝不用 that。

quizzes.title: 阅读：A cultural misunderstanding
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段关于跨文化沟通的短文。留意英语的委婉与「言外之意」。

helpMemoryTips.title: 委婉与习语（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'read between the lines'（听出言外之意）；英语常用委婉语气代替直接的「不」。

quizzes.readingPassage: When Li Wei started working in London, he made an interesting discovery about British culture. In China, he was used to being direct. But his British colleagues often said things like 'That might be a bit difficult' when they actually meant 'no'. At first, Li Wei was confused. He thought people were unsure, but really they were being polite. He also noticed that the British apologise a lot, even when something is not their fault. Over time, Li Wei learnt to 'read between the lines'. He realised that understanding a culture is just as important as speaking the language.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 李伟刚到伦敦工作时，对英国文化有了一个有趣的发现。在中国，他习惯直来直去。但他的英国同事常说「那可能有点难」，其实意思是「不行」。起初李伟很困惑，以为大家拿不定主意，其实他们是在委婉客气。他还注意到英国人很爱道歉，哪怕并不是他们的错。渐渐地，李伟学会了「听出言外之意」。他意识到，理解一种文化和会说这门语言同样重要。

readingQuestions.question: What did 'That might be difficult' really mean?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 「那可能有点难」其实是什么意思？

readingQuestions.question: What did he learn?
options: Culture matters as much as language

quizzes.title: 可分短语动词

sentences.sentence: 请把电视关掉。 → Please turn the TV ____.
我得查一下这个词。 → I need to look this word ____.
sentences.referenceExample: I need to look this word **up**.

sentences.sentence: 别把会议推迟。 → Don't put the meeting ____.
把你的外套脱掉。 → Take your coat ____.
他填好了表格。 → He filled the form ____.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 许多短语动词可以「分开」，而且宾语是代词时必须放在中间。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 代词放中间（Z30）
helpMemoryTips.text: turn the TV off / turn it off（代词必须放中间，不能说 turn off it）。

quizzes.title: 使役结构：have / get sth done

sentences.sentence: 我要去理发。 → I'm going to have my hair ____.
sentences.referenceExample: I'm going to have my hair **cut**.

sentences.sentence: 她把车修好了。 → She had her car ____.
我们在请人粉刷房子。 → We are having the house ____.
你应该去检查眼睛。 → You should have your eyes ____.
我把照片洗出来了。 → I got the photos ____.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词，表示「请／让别人做某事」。

helpMemoryTips.title: have/get + 宾语 + V3
helpMemoryTips.text: have my hair **cut**（让别人给我剪头发），不是我自己剪。get 更口语。

quizzes.title: 发音：连读与弱读

subjects.display: bread and butter, fish and chips
a lot of people, a cup of tea
I could have gone, she must have left
What do you want to do this evening?

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 功能词（to, and, of, have）在句中会弱读。这是自然英语的关键。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 弱读功能词（Z10）
helpMemoryTips.text: to→/tə/，and→/ən/，of→/əv/，have→/əv/。I could have gone → /kʊdəv/。

quizzes.title: 听力：A workplace briefing
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意被动和转述结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: 被动 + 转述
helpMemoryTips.text: we've been told（被动）；she has asked everyone to…（转述命令）；has been moved（被动）。

quizzes.readingPassage: Right, everyone, let me quickly go through this week's plan. The new project starts on Monday. Sarah will be leading the team, and she has asked everyone to send their reports by Friday. We've also been told that the client is visiting next Thursday, so the office must be tidy. If anyone has questions, please email me. Oh, and don't forget: the meeting on Wednesday has been moved to two o'clock. Thanks, everyone.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 好，各位，我快速过一下这周的安排。新项目周一开始。Sarah 将带领团队，她要求大家在周五前交报告。我们还被告知，客户下周四来访，所以办公室必须整洁。有问题请给我发邮件。哦，别忘了：周三的会议改到两点。谢谢大家。

readingQuestions.question: When does the new project start?
What time is Wednesday's meeting now?

quizzes.title: 听写：A news summary

subjects.display: The government has promised to help.
He said he would be late.
My uncle, who lives abroad, called me.
subjects.english: 我叔叔（他住在国外）给我打了电话。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 听句子并打出来。注意转述、被动和推断结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 结构要写全（Z29/Z27）
helpMemoryTips.text: 写出转述（he said he would…）、被动（has been cancelled）、推断（must have…）。

quizzes.title: 比较级的程度修饰

sentences.sentence: 这个贵多了。 → This is ____ more expensive.
他跑得快得多。 → He runs ____ faster.
今天稍微暖和一点。 → It's ____ warmer today.
这个好一点点。 → It's a ____ better.
她远比我高。 → She is ____ taller than me.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用 much/far/a bit/slightly 等来修饰比较级，说明差距的大小。

helpMemoryTips.title: 差距大 vs 小
helpMemoryTips.text: much / far / a lot + 比较级（差距大）；a bit / slightly + 比较级（差距小）。

quizzes.title: 阅读：The story behind the headline
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段关于新闻标题的短文。留意非限定从句和习语。

helpMemoryTips.title: 从句 + 习语（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: The article, **which was much calmer**（非限定从句）；'Don't judge a book by its cover'（习语）。

quizzes.readingPassage: Newspaper headlines are designed to catch our attention, but they don't always tell the whole story. Last week, one paper printed the headline: 'Robots to take all our jobs!' The article, which was much calmer than the headline, actually said that while some jobs will change, many new jobs will also be created. This is a common problem in the media. A shocking headline sells more papers, so writers often make things sound worse than they are. Experts advise readers to look beyond the headline and read the full story before forming an opinion. As the saying goes, 'Don't judge a book by its cover.'
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 报纸标题是为了吸引注意，但并不总是讲述事情的全貌。上周，一家报纸打出标题：「机器人将抢走我们所有的工作！」而那篇文章其实比标题冷静得多，说的是：虽然有些工作会改变，但也会创造出许多新工作。这是媒体的常见问题。耸动的标题更好卖，所以写手常把事情说得比实际更糟。专家建议读者别只看标题，先读完整篇再下结论。正如那句话所说：「别以封面评断一本书。」

readingQuestions.question: What is the problem with headlines?
What did the article really say?
options: New jobs will also be created

quizzes.title: 混合条件句

subjects.display: 如果我当时学了医，现在就是医生了。
如果我更有条理，就不会错过截止日期。
如果他昨晚睡了，现在就不累了。
如果她会开车，昨天就自己去了。

sentences.sentence: 如果我当时学了医，现在就是医生了。 → If I had studied medicine, I ____ be a doctor now.
sentences.english: 如果我当时学了医，现在就是医生了。
sentences.referenceExample: If I had studied medicine, I **would** be a doctor now.

sentences.sentence: 如果我更有条理，就不会错过截止日期。 → If I were more organised, I ____ have missed the deadline.
sentences.english: 如果我更有条理，就不会错过截止日期。
sentences.referenceExample: If I were more organised, I **wouldn't** have missed the deadline.

sentences.sentence: 如果他昨晚睡了，现在就不累了。 → If he had slept last night, he ____ be tired now.
sentences.english: 如果他昨晚睡了，现在就不累了。
sentences.referenceExample: If he had slept last night, he **wouldn't** be tired now.

sentences.sentence: 如果她会开车，昨天就自己去了。 → If she could drive, she ____ have gone yesterday.
sentences.english: 如果她会开车，昨天就自己去了。
sentences.referenceExample: If she could drive, she **would** have gone yesterday.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 混合条件句把不同时间连接起来：过去的条件影响现在的结果，或反之。

helpMemoryTips.title: 跨时间的假设
helpMemoryTips.text: 过去条件→现在结果：If I had studied…, I would **be**… now；现在条件→过去结果亦可。

quizzes.title: 高级动词搭配

sentences.sentence: 我不习惯早起。 → I'm not used to ____ up early.
sentences.referenceExample: I'm not used to **getting** up early.

sentences.sentence: 他往往话很多。 → He tends ____ a lot.
她设法完成了。 → She managed ____ it.
我避免吃太多糖。 → I avoid ____ too much sugar.
我们期待见到你。 → We look forward ____ you.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 许多动词和短语后接固定的形式，必须准确记忆——尤其是 to 作介词时。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ to 有时是介词（Z26）
helpMemoryTips.text: be used to / look forward to + V-ing（to 是介词！）；tend / manage + to do；avoid + V-ing。

quizzes.title: 分词短语

subjects.display: 不知道该说什么，他保持沉默。
因为天气好，我们去散步了。

sentences.sentence: 做完工作后，她回家了。 → ____ finished her work, she went home.
sentences.referenceExample: **Having** finished her work, she went home.

sentences.sentence: 从山顶看，城市很小。 → ____ from the top, the city looks small.
sentences.referenceExample: **Seen** from the top, the city looks small.

sentences.sentence: 不知道该说什么，他保持沉默。 → ____ knowing what to say, he stayed silent.
sentences.english: 不知道该说什么，他保持沉默。
sentences.referenceExample: **Not** knowing what to say, he stayed silent.

sentences.sentence: 因为天气好，我们去散步了。 → The weather ____ nice, we went for a walk.
sentences.english: 因为天气好，我们去散步了。
sentences.referenceExample: The weather **being** nice, we went for a walk.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 分词短语让句子更简洁，用来代替时间、原因或方式从句。

helpMemoryTips.title: 三种分词
helpMemoryTips.text: Having + V3（完成）、V-ing（主动/同时）、V3（被动）替代从句：Having finished…, she left。

quizzes.title: 开口说：展开抽象论证

subjects.english: 我们必须考虑几个因素。

subjects.display: On the one hand … yet on the other …

subjects.english: 这引出了一个更深层的问题。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用这些短语组织抽象、复杂的论证。听并跟读。

helpMemoryTips.title: 论证语篇
helpMemoryTips.text: 先框定问题，再分层展开，最后收束：This is a complex issue… Ultimately…。

quizzes.title: 名词化

subjects.display: 价格的上涨引发了抗议。

sentences.sentence: 政府决定提高税收。 → The government made a ____ to raise taxes.
sentences.referenceExample: The government made a **decision** to raise taxes.

sentences.sentence: 这项发现改变了科学。 → The ____ changed science.
价格的上涨引发了抗议。 → The ____ in prices caused protests.
sentences.english: 价格的上涨引发了抗议。

sentences.sentence: 他的解释很清楚。 → His ____ was clear.
我们讨论了这个问题。 → We had a ____ about the problem.
sentences.referenceExample: We had a **discussion** about the problem.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 正式书面英语常把动词或形容词变成名词，使文风更凝练、客观。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 动词 → 名词（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: decide→decision，explain→explanation，increase（动/名）。名词化让英语书面语更「学术」。

quizzes.title: 语篇衔接：指代与替代

subjects.display: 我买了两本书。这本很好。
他说他会来，我也这么认为。
有些人喜欢茶，另一些喜欢咖啡。

sentences.sentence: 我买了两本书。这本很好。 → I bought two books. ____ one is good.
sentences.english: 我买了两本书。这本很好。
sentences.referenceExample: I bought two books. **This** one is good.

sentences.sentence: 我需要一支笔。你有吗？ → I need a pen. Do you have ____?
sentences.referenceExample: I need a pen. Do you have **one**?

sentences.sentence: 他说他会来，我也这么认为。 → He said he'd come, and I think ____ too.
sentences.english: 他说他会来，我也这么认为。
sentences.referenceExample: He said he'd come, and I think **so** too.

sentences.sentence: 这个方案比那个好。 → This plan is better than ____ one.
sentences.referenceExample: This plan is better than **that** one.

sentences.sentence: 有些人喜欢茶，另一些喜欢咖啡。 → Some like tea; ____ like coffee.
sentences.english: 有些人喜欢茶，另一些喜欢咖啡。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用 this/that/one/so/others 指代前文，避免重复，让文章连贯。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 避免重复（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 用 one 替代可数名词，so 替代整句，this/that/others 指代前文——英语靠这些衔接词织成篇章。

quizzes.title: 听力：A university lecture
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。学术讲座里有名词化和被动结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: 学术语体
helpMemoryTips.text: decisions are influenced（被动）；is known as（被动）；decision-making（名词化）。

quizzes.readingPassage: Good morning. Today's lecture is about the psychology of decision-making. Many people believe that we make choices logically, weighing up the facts. However, research over the past few decades has shown that this is rarely the case. In fact, most of our decisions are influenced by emotion, habit, and the way information is presented. For example, if a product is described as '90% fat-free' rather than '10% fat', people are far more likely to buy it — even though the two statements mean exactly the same thing. This is known as the 'framing effect'.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 早上好。今天的讲座讲的是决策心理学。许多人以为我们是理性地做选择、权衡事实。然而，过去几十年的研究表明，情况很少如此。事实上，我们的大多数决定都受到情绪、习惯以及信息呈现方式的影响。例如，如果一件产品被描述为「90% 无脂」而不是「含 10% 脂肪」，人们购买的可能性会大得多——尽管两种说法意思完全相同。这被称为「框架效应」。

quizzes.title: 冠词：抽象与泛指（进阶）

subjects.display: 教育是通往机会的钥匙。

sentences.sentence: 教育是通往机会的钥匙。 → ____ is the key to opportunity.
sentences.english: 教育是通往机会的钥匙。

sentences.sentence: 穷人往往受苦最多。 → ____ poor often suffer most.
互联网改变了社会。 → ____ internet has changed society.
幸福买不到。 → ____ cannot be bought.
十九世纪见证了巨变。 → ____ nineteenth century saw great change.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 抽象名词泛指用零冠词；the + 形容词表一类人；独一无二、世纪等用 the。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 这里的冠词很微妙（Z11）
helpMemoryTips.text: Education is…（零冠词，抽象）；the poor（一类人）；the internet、the 19th century（the）。

quizzes.title: 阅读：The ethics of technology
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段关于科技伦理的议论文。留意强调句、被动和名词化。

helpMemoryTips.title: 强调句 + 被动
helpMemoryTips.text: What is clear is that…（强调句）；can no longer be left（被动）；the questions it raises（省略 that 的从句）。

quizzes.readingPassage: As technology advances, society faces increasingly difficult ethical questions. Consider the case of self-driving cars. If an accident is unavoidable, how should the car be programmed to react? Should it protect its passengers at all costs, or should it minimise the total number of injuries, even if that means harming its owner? There is no easy answer. What is clear, however, is that these decisions can no longer be left to engineers alone. Philosophers, lawmakers and the public must all be involved. The technology may be new, but the moral questions it raises are as old as humanity itself.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 随着科技进步，社会面临越来越棘手的伦理问题。以自动驾驶汽车为例：如果一场事故不可避免，汽车该被设定成如何反应？是不惜一切保护乘客，还是尽量减少总伤亡——哪怕这意味着伤及车主本人？这没有简单的答案。然而，有一点很清楚：这些决定不能再只交给工程师。哲学家、立法者和公众都必须参与其中。技术也许是新的，但它引发的道德问题，和人类本身一样古老。

readingQuestions.question: Who should be involved in the decisions?

quizzes.title: 强调句（分裂句）

subjects.display: 正是在巴黎我们初次相遇。
让我惊讶的是他的诚实。

sentences.sentence: 正是他打破了窗户。 → ____ was he who broke the window.
sentences.referenceExample: **It** was he who broke the window.

sentences.sentence: 我需要的是时间。 → ____ I need is time.
正是在巴黎我们初次相遇。 → It was in Paris ____ we first met.
sentences.english: 正是在巴黎我们初次相遇。
sentences.referenceExample: It was in Paris **that** we first met.

sentences.sentence: 让我惊讶的是他的诚实。 → What surprised me ____ his honesty.
sentences.english: 让我惊讶的是他的诚实。

sentences.sentence: 我真正想要的是安宁。 → What I really want ____ peace.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用 It is/was … that … 和 What … is … 来突出句子中的某个信息。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 突出重点（Z22）
helpMemoryTips.text: 中文靠「是…的」和主题句突出信息；英语用 It is X that… 和 What… is…。这是主题突出的桥梁。

quizzes.title: the … the …（越……越……）

subjects.display: 我们等得越久，就越紧张。

sentences.sentence: 越快越好。 → The faster, ____ better.
你学得越多，懂得越多。 → The more you learn, ____ more you know.
sentences.referenceExample: The more you learn, **the** more you know.

sentences.sentence: 天气越热，我越累。 → The hotter it gets, ____ more tired I feel.
sentences.referenceExample: The hotter it gets, **the** more tired I feel.

sentences.sentence: 价格越高，需求越低。 → The higher the price, ____ lower the demand.
sentences.referenceExample: The higher the price, **the** lower the demand.

sentences.sentence: 我们等得越久，就越紧张。 → The longer we wait, ____ more nervous we get.
sentences.english: 我们等得越久，就越紧张。
sentences.referenceExample: The longer we wait, **the** more nervous we get.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用「the + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 …」表达「越……越……」。

helpMemoryTips.title: 双比较级
helpMemoryTips.text: The + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 …：The more you learn, the more you know。

quizzes.title: 发音：强调与对比语调

subjects.display: I didn't say SHE took it — I said HE did.
We need pens, paper, and folders.
It was HER idea, not mine.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用重音和音调突出关键词、表达对比。移动重音会改变句子的含义。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 重音改变含义（Z9）
helpMemoryTips.text: "I didn't say SHE took it" 里重读哪个词，意思就不同。用语调传达态度和对比。

quizzes.title: 搭配：make / do / take / have
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 这些常见动词的搭配很挑剔，用错就是典型的中式英语。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 搭配要成组记（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: make a decision（不是 do a decision）、do homework、take a photo、have a break。整组记忆。

quizzes.title: 听力：A panel discussion
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意条件句和名词化。

helpMemoryTips.title: 条件 + 名词化
helpMemoryTips.text: If we fail to act, our cities will become…（条件）；the cost of doing nothing（名词化）。

quizzes.readingPassage: Let's turn to our next topic: the future of cities. Professor Adams, you've argued that cities will become greener. Could you explain? — Certainly. As populations grow, we simply cannot continue building in the old way. Cities of the future will need vertical gardens, better public transport, and buildings that produce their own energy. — But isn't that expensive? — In the short term, yes. However, the cost of doing nothing would be far higher. If we fail to act, our cities will become unliveable.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 我们进入下一个话题：城市的未来。Adams 教授，您认为城市会变得更绿色，能解释一下吗？——当然。随着人口增长，我们不能再以旧方式建设。未来的城市需要垂直花园、更好的公共交通，以及能自己产能的建筑。——但那不是很贵吗？——短期内是的。然而，什么都不做的代价会高得多。如果我们不行动，城市将变得无法居住。

readingQuestions.question: What does he say about the cost?

quizzes.title: 听写：An academic paragraph

subjects.display: The research shows a clear pattern.
subjects.english: 研究显示出一个明显的规律。

subjects.display: It is widely believed that the climate is changing.
subjects.english: 人们普遍认为气候正在变化。

subjects.display: Having considered the evidence, we can draw a conclusion.
subjects.english: 在考虑了证据之后，我们可以得出结论。

subjects.display: The more we invest, the greater the benefit.
subjects.english: 我们投入越多，收益越大。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 听句子并打出来。注意名词化、被动和分词结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 学术结构（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 写出名词化（findings, implications）、被动（it is believed）、分词（having considered）。

quizzes.title: 阅读：An argumentative essay
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一篇议论文。留意定语从句、名词化和论证连接词。

helpMemoryTips.title: 议论文结构
helpMemoryTips.text: in which…（定语从句）；Moreover / however（论证连接）；Investment…（名词化收尾）。

quizzes.readingPassage: Should university education be free? Supporters argue that free education creates a fairer society, in which talented students are not held back by their financial background. Moreover, a well-educated population benefits everyone, since it leads to a stronger economy and greater innovation. Opponents, however, point out that 'free' education is not really free: it is paid for through higher taxes. They also argue that if everyone can attend university, degrees may lose their value. In my view, while the cost is a genuine concern, the long-term benefits of an educated society outweigh the disadvantages. Investment in education is, quite simply, an investment in the future.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 大学教育应该免费吗？支持者认为，免费教育造就更公平的社会，让有才华的学生不再因经济背景而受限。此外，受过良好教育的人口惠及所有人，因为它带来更强的经济和更多的创新。然而，反对者指出，「免费」教育其实并不免费：它靠更高的税收买单。他们还认为，如果人人都能上大学，文凭可能会贬值。在我看来，尽管成本是一个真实的顾虑，但受教育社会的长远收益超过其弊端。对教育的投资，说到底，就是对未来的投资。

quizzes.title: 否定副词前置引起的倒装

subjects.display: 我从没见过这样的美景。
他不但迟到，还忘了带报告。
任何情况下都不应开门。

sentences.sentence: 我从没见过这样的美景。 → Never ____ I seen such beauty.
sentences.english: 我从没见过这样的美景。

sentences.sentence: 他不但迟到，还忘了带报告。 → Not only ____ he late, but he also forgot the report.
sentences.english: 他不但迟到，还忘了带报告。
sentences.referenceExample: Not only **was** he late, but he also forgot the report.

sentences.sentence: 他一到就下起了雨。 → No sooner ____ he arrived than it rained.
sentences.referenceExample: No sooner **had** he arrived than it rained.

sentences.sentence: 我几乎不了解她。 → Little ____ I know her.
任何情况下都不应开门。 → Under no circumstances ____ you open the door.
sentences.english: 任何情况下都不应开门。
sentences.referenceExample: Under no circumstances **should** you open the door.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 否定或限制性副词放在句首时，主谓要倒装——这是正式、强调的写法。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 否定开头就倒装（Z22）
helpMemoryTips.text: Never / Not only / Little / Under no circumstances 放句首 → 借助动词倒装（Never **have** I…）。

quizzes.title: 条件句的倒装（省略 if）

subjects.display: 要是我早知道，就会帮你。
万一你需要帮助，打给我。
要是没有你的帮助，我们就失败了。

sentences.sentence: 要是我早知道，就会帮你。 → ____ I known, I would have helped.
sentences.english: 要是我早知道，就会帮你。
sentences.referenceExample: **Had** I known, I would have helped.

sentences.sentence: 如果我是你，我会拒绝。 → ____ I you, I would refuse.
万一你需要帮助，打给我。 → ____ you need help, call me.
sentences.english: 万一你需要帮助，打给我。

sentences.sentence: 要是没有你的帮助，我们就失败了。 → Had it not been for your help, we ____ have failed.
sentences.english: 要是没有你的帮助，我们就失败了。
sentences.referenceExample: Had it not been for your help, we **would** have failed.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 正式条件句可以省略 if，改用倒装。

helpMemoryTips.title: Had / Were / Should 开头
helpMemoryTips.text: Had I known… = If I had known…；Were I… = If I were…；Should you… = If you should…。

quizzes.title: 前置强调

subjects.display: 这样的错误绝不能重犯。
山谷中坐落着一座小村庄。
他说的话我一个字都不信。

sentences.sentence: 这样的错误绝不能重犯。 → Such mistakes ____ never be repeated.
sentences.english: 这样的错误绝不能重犯。

sentences.sentence: 钱我没有，时间我有。 → Money I don't have; time I ____.
sentences.referenceExample: Money I don't have; time I **do**.

sentences.sentence: 山谷中坐落着一座小村庄。 → In the valley ____ a small village.
sentences.english: 山谷中坐落着一座小村庄。
sentences.referenceExample: In the valley **lay** a small village.

sentences.sentence: 他说的话我一个字都不信。 → Not a word ____ I believe.
sentences.english: 他说的话我一个字都不信。

sentences.sentence: 她这么说，也这么做了。 → So she said, and so she ____.
sentences.referenceExample: So she said, and so she **did**.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 把想强调的成分提到句首，让语气更有力，有时会引起倒装。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 主题前置（Z22）
helpMemoryTips.text: 源自中文的主题句：把强调的部分提前——Money I don't have; time I **do**。

quizzes.title: 开口说：正式与非正式语体

subjects.display: Would you like me to assist you?
I'm afraid that won't be possible.
I was wondering if you could help me.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 同一个意思，正式和非正式场合说法不同。听并跟读，感受差异。

helpMemoryTips.title: 语体的选择（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 正式场合更委婉、更间接：Would you like me to assist you? vs Need a hand?

quizzes.title: 模糊限制与语气软化

subjects.display: 这在某种程度上是对的。

sentences.sentence: 这在某种程度上是对的。 → This is, to some ____, true.
sentences.english: 这在某种程度上是对的。

sentences.sentence: 似乎有个误会。 → There ____ to be a misunderstanding.
这往往是这样。 → This ____ to be the case.
可以说结果是成功的。 → The result was, ____, a success.
我倾向于认为他错了。 → I'm ____ to think he's wrong.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 学术和正式英语常用模糊限制语来软化语气、避免绝对化。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 别太绝对（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: tend to / appear to / arguably / to some extent 让论断更谨慎。中文更直接，注意补上这层委婉。

quizzes.title: 客观被动转述

subjects.display: 人们认为运动有益健康。
据报道事故发生在夜里。

sentences.sentence: 据说他很有钱。 → It is ____ that he is rich.
sentences.referenceExample: It is **said** that he is rich.

sentences.sentence: 人们认为运动有益健康。 → Exercise is ____ to be good for health.
sentences.english: 人们认为运动有益健康。
sentences.referenceExample: Exercise is **thought** to be good for health.

sentences.sentence: 据报道事故发生在夜里。 → The accident is ____ to have happened at night.
sentences.english: 据报道事故发生在夜里。
sentences.referenceExample: The accident is **reported** to have happened at night.

sentences.sentence: 大家普遍相信…… → It is widely ____ that ...
他被认为是最佳人选。 → He is ____ to be the best candidate.
sentences.referenceExample: He is **considered** to be the best candidate.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用 It is said that… / 主语 + be + 过去分词 + to do 客观转述，不点名消息来源。

helpMemoryTips.title: 两种句型
helpMemoryTips.text: It is said/believed that…；或 He is thought/said to be…。常见于新闻和学术。

quizzes.title: 听力：A political interview
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。政治访谈中大量使用委婉和习语。

helpMemoryTips.title: 委婉 + 习语（Z31/Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: I would say、too early to judge（委婉）；Rome wasn't built in a day（习语）；What I would ask…（强调句）。

quizzes.readingPassage: Minister, thank you for joining us. Critics say your new housing policy has failed. How do you respond? — Well, I would say it's too early to judge. It is true that progress has been slower than we hoped. However, we've laid the foundations for long-term change. — But families are still waiting for homes. — I understand their frustration, and I share it. What I would ask is for a little more patience. Rome, as they say, wasn't built in a day. — Minister, thank you.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 部长，感谢您接受采访。批评者说您的新住房政策失败了，您怎么回应？——嗯，我会说现在下结论还为时过早。诚然，进展比我们希望的要慢。然而，我们已经为长期变革打下了基础。——但families仍在等待住房。——我理解他们的沮丧，我也感同身受。我想请求的是多一点耐心。正如人们所说，罗马不是一天建成的。——部长，谢谢您。

readingQuestions.question: How does the minister respond to criticism?

quizzes.title: 语篇连接词

subjects.display: 尽管如此，我们仍需谨慎。
相比之下，第二种方案更便宜。
也就是说，需要更多时间。

sentences.sentence: 尽管如此，我们仍需谨慎。 → ____, we must be cautious.
sentences.english: 尽管如此，我们仍需谨慎。

sentences.sentence: 此外，还有其他因素。 → ____, there are other factors.
相比之下，第二种方案更便宜。 → By ____, the second option is cheaper.
sentences.english: 相比之下，第二种方案更便宜。
sentences.referenceExample: By **contrast**, the second option is cheaper.

sentences.sentence: 换句话说，我们失败了。 → In ____ words, we failed.
也就是说，需要更多时间。 → That is to ____, more time is needed.
sentences.english: 也就是说，需要更多时间。
sentences.referenceExample: That is to **say**, more time is needed.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用 nonetheless、moreover、by contrast 等连接观点，让论述更有条理、更正式。

helpMemoryTips.title: 连接词的功能
helpMemoryTips.text: nonetheless（尽管如此）、moreover（此外）、by contrast（相比之下）、in other words（换言之）。

quizzes.title: 阅读：An opinion column
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一篇观点专栏。留意修辞、倒装和习语式的表达。

helpMemoryTips.title: 修辞语体
helpMemoryTips.text: so too does thought（倒装）；We would do well to…（委婉建议）；排比与对比增强说服力。

quizzes.readingPassage: There is a growing tendency, especially among politicians, to speak in slogans rather than substance. Complex problems are reduced to three-word phrases, as if a catchy rhyme could solve a housing crisis or repair a broken health service. This, I would argue, is not merely lazy; it is dangerous. When language becomes empty, so too does thought. A society that stops demanding careful argument will, sooner or later, stop receiving it. We would do well to remember that the loudest voice is rarely the wisest, and that a simple answer to a difficult question is almost always the wrong one.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 有一种日益增长的倾向，尤其在政客中间：说口号，而非实质。复杂的问题被简化成三字短语，仿佛一句朗朗上口的顺口溜就能解决住房危机或修复崩坏的医疗系统。我要说，这不仅仅是懒惰，更是危险。当语言变得空洞，思想也随之空洞。一个不再要求缜密论证的社会，迟早也将不再得到缜密论证。我们最好记住：最大的嗓门很少是最智慧的，而对难题给出的简单答案，几乎总是错的。

readingQuestions.question: What is the writer's view of simple answers?

quizzes.title: 让步：whereas / albeit / despite

subjects.display: 尽管下雨，比赛还是进行了。
有些人喜欢城市，而另一些喜欢乡村。
虽然努力了，她还是失败了。
尽管有困难，他们成功了。

sentences.sentence: 他很聪明，尽管有点懒。 → He is clever, ____ a little lazy.
sentences.referenceExample: He is clever, **albeit** a little lazy.

sentences.sentence: 尽管下雨，比赛还是进行了。 → ____ the rain, the match went ahead.
sentences.english: 尽管下雨，比赛还是进行了。
sentences.referenceExample: **Despite** the rain, the match went ahead.

sentences.sentence: 有些人喜欢城市，而另一些喜欢乡村。 → Some like the city, ____ others prefer the country.
sentences.english: 有些人喜欢城市，而另一些喜欢乡村。
sentences.referenceExample: Some like the city, **whereas** others prefer the country.

sentences.sentence: 虽然努力了，她还是失败了。 → ____ she tried, she failed.
sentences.english: 虽然努力了，她还是失败了。

sentences.sentence: 尽管有困难，他们成功了。 → They succeeded ____ spite of the difficulties.
sentences.english: 尽管有困难，他们成功了。
sentences.referenceExample: They succeeded **in** spite of the difficulties.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 让步与对比连接词各有搭配，用对了文风才地道。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 搭配不同（Z25）
helpMemoryTips.text: although/though + 句子；despite / in spite of + 名词或 -ing；whereas 表对比；albeit 很正式。

quizzes.title: 高级搭配与习语

sentences.sentence: 下定决心 → to ____ up your mind
接受（并释怀） → to ____ to terms with it
起重要作用 → to play a key ____
打破僵局 → to break the ____
权衡利弊 → to weigh the ____ and cons

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 地道的搭配和习语要整体记忆——这是摆脱中式英语的关键。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 成组记忆（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: make up your mind、come to terms with、break the ice——别逐字直译中文。

quizzes.title: 发音：有说服力的语调

subjects.display: It is unfair, it is unwise, and it is unnecessary.
How much longer must we wait?
We can do better, and we must.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用停顿、重音和排比增强说服力；语调传达信念。

helpMemoryTips.title: 修辞节奏
helpMemoryTips.text: 三段排比、反问、恰当停顿，让讲话更有力量。

quizzes.title: 高级短语与介词动词

sentences.sentence: 这归结为金钱问题。 → It ____ down to money.
我们必须坚持到底。 → We must ____ on to the end.
sentences.referenceExample: We must **carry** on to the end.

sentences.sentence: 那个计划落空了。 → The plan ____ through.
他偶然发现了真相。 → He ____ across the truth by chance.
sentences.referenceExample: He **came** across the truth by chance.

sentences.sentence: 我支持你的决定。 → I ____ you up.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 高级短语动词常有抽象含义，不能字面理解。

helpMemoryTips.title: 抽象含义（Z30）
helpMemoryTips.text: come down to（归结为）、fall through（落空）、come across（偶然遇到）、back up（支持）。

quizzes.title: 听力：A business negotiation
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意谈判中的委婉条件句和使役结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: 条件 + 使役
helpMemoryTips.text: If you could reduce…we'd be prepared（委婉条件）；have the contract drawn up（使役被动）。

quizzes.readingPassage: Thank you for meeting us. Let me be direct: we're very interested in your product, but the price is a concern. — I appreciate your honesty. What did you have in mind? — If you could reduce the price by ten per cent, we'd be prepared to sign a two-year contract. — That's a significant reduction. However, for a two-year commitment, I think we could offer eight per cent. — Let's say nine, and we have a deal. — Nine it is. I'll have the contract drawn up.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 感谢与我们会面。我就直说了：我们对贵方的产品很感兴趣，但价格是个顾虑。——感谢您的坦诚。您有什么想法？——如果您能把价格降低百分之十，我们愿意签一份两年的合同。——这个降幅可不小。不过，考虑到两年的承诺，我想我们可以让百分之八。——就九个点吧，成交。——那就九个点。我这就让人把合同拟好。

readingQuestions.question: What is the buyer concerned about?
What does the buyer offer in return for a discount?
What discount do they agree on?

quizzes.title: 听写：A formal email

subjects.display: I am writing to enquire about your services.
subjects.english: 我写信是想咨询贵方的服务。

subjects.display: I would be grateful if you could reply soon.
subjects.english: 如蒙尽快回复，我将不胜感激。

subjects.display: Please find attached the requested document.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Should you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact me.
subjects.english: 如有任何问题，请随时与我联系。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 听句子并打出来。注意正式邮件的固定表达。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 正式表达（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 写出 I would be grateful if…、Please find attached…、Should you have any questions…。英式拼写 enquire。

quizzes.title: 阅读：Two reviews, two registers
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读两则语体截然不同的评价。本课的核心：语体意识。

helpMemoryTips.title: 语体对比（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 正式：exquisite、considerable skill；非正式：well nice、defo、lol。流利 = 会在对的场合用对的语体。

quizzes.readingPassage: Here are two reviews of the same restaurant. The first, from a food critic, reads: 'The dishes, though modest in appearance, reveal a chef of considerable skill; the balance of flavours is, quite frankly, exquisite.' The second, posted online by a customer, says: 'Food was well nice! A bit pricey but worth it lol. Will defo go back!' Both reviews are positive, yet they could hardly be more different. The first uses careful, formal language; the second is casual and full of slang. Neither is 'wrong'. Rather, each is appropriate to its context — and knowing which register to use, and when, is one of the true marks of fluency.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 这里有对同一家餐厅的两则评价。第一则出自美食评论家：「这些菜肴外表朴素，却显露出一位技艺不凡的厨师；风味的平衡，坦白说，堪称精妙。」第二则由一位顾客发在网上：「东西超好吃！有点小贵但值了 哈哈。绝对还会再去！」两则都是好评，却几乎再不同不过。前者用词讲究、正式；后者随意，满是俚语。两者都没有「错」。相反，各自都契合其语境——而知道该在何时使用哪种语体，正是真正流利的标志之一。

readingQuestions.question: How are the two reviews similar?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 两则评价有什么共同点？

readingQuestions.question: What is 'a true mark of fluency'?

quizzes.title: 情态的细微差别

subjects.display: 他这时候应该已经到了。

sentences.sentence: 他这时候应该已经到了。 → He ____ have arrived by now.
sentences.english: 他这时候应该已经到了。

sentences.sentence: 你本可以告诉我的。 → You ____ have told me.
她当时本不必来的。 → She ____ have come.
我本应该更早打电话。 → I ____ have called earlier.
那样本来会更好。 → It ____ have been better.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: should/could/would/needn't + have + V3 表达对过去的评价、遗憾或推测。

helpMemoryTips.title: 过去情态
helpMemoryTips.text: should have（本该）、could have（本可以）、needn't have（本不必）、would have（本会）。

quizzes.title: 完成与进行体的细腻区别

subjects.display: 到明年我就在这工作十年了。
那本书我看了好几周了（还没看完）。
等你到时我已经吃完了。

sentences.sentence: 到明年我就在这工作十年了。 → By next year, I will have ____ working here for ten years.
sentences.english: 到明年我就在这工作十年了。
sentences.referenceExample: By next year, I will have **been** working here for ten years.

sentences.sentence: 我一直在想这件事。 → I've ____ thinking about it.
他已经走了（人不在了）。 → He has ____.
那本书我看了好几周了（还没看完）。 → I've been ____ that book for weeks.
sentences.english: 那本书我看了好几周了（还没看完）。
sentences.referenceExample: I've been **reading** that book for weeks.

sentences.sentence: 等你到时我已经吃完了。 → By the time you arrive, I will have ____.
sentences.english: 等你到时我已经吃完了。
sentences.referenceExample: By the time you arrive, I will have **finished**.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 完成时看「结果」，进行时看「过程」；将来完成、完成进行表达细微的时间层次。

helpMemoryTips.title: 结果 vs 过程（Z18）
helpMemoryTips.text: have done（强调结果）vs have been doing（强调过程/持续）；by then, I will have done。

quizzes.title: 省略与替代

subjects.display: 他们说要下雨，我也这么想。
你想要的话可以拿一个。

sentences.sentence: 我喜欢，她也喜欢。 → I like it, and so ____ she.
sentences.referenceExample: I like it, and so **does** she.

sentences.sentence: 你想去吗？——很想。 → Do you want to go? — I'd love ____.
sentences.referenceExample: Do you want to go? — I'd love **to**.

sentences.sentence: 他们说要下雨，我也这么想。 → They say it'll rain. I think ____.
sentences.english: 他们说要下雨，我也这么想。
sentences.referenceExample: They say it'll rain. I think **so**.

sentences.sentence: 他会来，但她不会。 → He'll come, but she ____.
你想要的话可以拿一个。 → You can have one if you want ____.
sentences.english: 你想要的话可以拿一个。
sentences.referenceExample: You can have one if you want **to**.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用 so / to / do / one 等替代前文，避免重复，让语言自然流畅。

helpMemoryTips.title: 替代手段（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: so（替代整句）、to（替代动词短语）、do/does（替代动词）、one（替代可数名词）。

quizzes.title: 发音：习语与自然节奏

subjects.display: To be honest, I couldn't care less.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 地道流利 = 习语 + 自然节奏 + 连读弱读。像母语者一样把词连起来。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 流利的节奏（Z10）
helpMemoryTips.text: 习语脱口而出、功能词弱读、词与词连读——这才是接近母语的语感。

quizzes.title: 习语与固定表达

sentences.sentence: 小菜一碟 → a piece of ____
花大价钱 → cost an arm and a ____
倾盆大雨 → to rain ____ and dogs
一举两得 → to kill two ____ with one stone
sentences.referenceExample: to kill two **birds** with one stone

sentences.sentence: 千载难逢 → once in a blue ____

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 习语不能字面翻译。整体记忆，用在合适的语境。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 别逐字直译（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 习语是文化的结晶：a piece of cake（小菜一碟）、cost an arm and a leg（花大价钱）。

quizzes.title: 词的褒贬色彩

subjects.display: 一栋便宜的房子（可含贬义）。

sentences.sentence: 这位政治家很坚定（褒）。 → The politician is ____.
这位政治家很固执（贬）。 → The politician is ____.
一栋便宜的房子（可含贬义）。 → a ____ house
sentences.english: 一栋便宜的房子（可含贬义）。

sentences.sentence: 一栋实惠的房子（褒）。 → an ____ house

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 许多同义词意思相近，但褒贬色彩不同。选词见修养。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 褒义还是贬义？（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: determined（褒：坚定）vs stubborn（贬：固执）；affordable（褒）vs cheap（可含贬义）。

quizzes.title: 听力：Irony & humour
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。关键是听出反讽——说的和真正的意思相反。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 反讽（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'Truly, we are living in the future' 是反讽：字面在夸，实则在讽刺。靠语气和上下文判断。

quizzes.readingPassage: So, I bought one of those 'smart' home devices last month. You know, the ones that are supposed to make your life easier. Well, let me tell you how my morning went. I asked it to turn on the lights. It played jazz. I asked it to play music. It ordered fifty rolls of toilet paper. And when I finally, in desperation, shouted 'Help!', it cheerfully replied: 'I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that.' Truly, we are living in the future.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 话说，我上个月买了那种「智能」家居设备。你懂的，就是号称能让生活更轻松的那种。来，让我说说我那天早上过得怎么样。我叫它开灯，它放起了爵士乐。我叫它放音乐，它订了五十卷厕纸。最后我绝望地喊「救命！」，它欢快地回答：「抱歉，我没太听清。」我们，真是活在未来啊。

readingQuestions.question: What is the speaker really saying about the device?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 说话人其实在说这个设备怎么样？

readingQuestions.question: Is the speaker being serious at the end?

quizzes.title: 强调与特殊结构

subjects.display: 她的确来了，虽然迟到了。

sentences.sentence: 我确实告诉过你。 → I ____ tell you.
正是这一点让我担心。 → It is this that ____ me.
他就是不肯听。 → He simply ____ listen.
我一点也不在乎。 → I couldn't care ____.
她的确来了，虽然迟到了。 → She ____ come, albeit late.
sentences.english: 她的确来了，虽然迟到了。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用助动词 do、强调句和否定倒装突出信息、加强语气。

helpMemoryTips.title: 强调手段（Z22）
helpMemoryTips.text: 用 do 强调肯定（I **did** tell you）；强调句 It is…that…；否定倒装。

quizzes.title: 阅读：A satirical article
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一篇讽刺文章。关键是识别夸张背后的讽刺，别当真。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 讽刺文体（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 用荒诞的夸张来批评现实观点（「快乐是简单的选择」）。识别出它并非字面真实。

quizzes.readingPassage: In a bold move to improve public health, the government has announced that from next year, all citizens will be required to feel happy at all times. Frowning in public will carry a small fine, while excessive sighing may result in a mandatory 'joy workshop'. A spokesperson explained: 'We believe happiness is a simple choice. If people are unhappy, it is clearly their own fault.' Critics have pointed out that poverty, stress and poor healthcare might have something to do with it — but such negativity, the government insists, is exactly the problem. The scheme will be funded by a new tax on umbrellas, since rain, too, has been declared unpatriotic.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 为改善公众健康，政府大胆宣布：从明年起，全体公民必须时刻感到快乐。在公共场合皱眉将被处以小额罚款，而过度叹气可能被强制参加「快乐工作坊」。一位发言人解释道：「我们认为快乐是一个简单的选择。如果人们不快乐，那显然是他们自己的错。」批评者指出，贫困、压力和糟糕的医疗或许与此有关——但政府坚称，这种消极情绪正是问题所在。该计划将由一项新的雨伞税提供资金，因为下雨也已被宣布为不爱国。

readingQuestions.question: Is this article describing a real policy?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 这篇文章在描述真实政策吗？

readingQuestions.question: What is the article criticising?
options: The idea that happiness is just a choice

quizzes.title: 短语动词网络：put

sentences.sentence: 我受不了这噪音了。 → I can't put up ____ this noise.
sentences.referenceExample: I can't put up **with** this noise.

sentences.sentence: 别把会议推迟了。 → Don't put the meeting ____.
把书放下。 → Put the book ____.
请把我转接给经理。 → Please put me ____ to the manager.
sentences.referenceExample: Please put me **through** to the manager.

sentences.sentence: 消防员扑灭了火。 → The firefighters put ____ the fire.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 同一个动词配不同小品词，意思迥异。put 是典型例子。

helpMemoryTips.title: put 的家族（Z30）
helpMemoryTips.text: put up with（忍受）、put off（推迟）、put out（扑灭）、put through（接通）、put down（放下）。

quizzes.title: 语体转换

subjects.display: 正式：这确实令人印象深刻。

sentences.sentence: 非正式：帮个忙。 → Give me a ____.
正式：我必须先告辞。 → I must take my ____.
非正式：收到你消息了。 → Got your ____.
正式：这确实令人印象深刻。 → That is most ____.
sentences.english: 正式：这确实令人印象深刻。

sentences.sentence: 非正式：等一下。 → Hang ____ a sec.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 同一意思在正式与非正式之间转换。掌握这种对应是高级能力。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 正式 ↔ 非正式（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: give me a hand（非正式）↔ assist me（正式）；hang on（非正式）↔ please wait（正式）。

quizzes.title: 发音：韵律与态度

subjects.display: Oh, great. Just what I needed.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 同一句话，语调不同，态度（真诚、讽刺、犹豫）就不同。

helpMemoryTips.title: 语调即态度（Z9）
helpMemoryTips.text: "Oh, great" 可以真诚，也可以讽刺——全看语调。用声音传达真正的意思。

quizzes.title: 搭配的精准
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 表示「强、重、深」时要选对形容词，搭配错了就不地道。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 强度搭配（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: heavy rain（不是 big rain）、strong accent、deep regret、fast asleep、high praise。

quizzes.title: 听力：A literary reading
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意营造氛围的文学手法。

helpMemoryTips.title: 文学手法（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 拟人（windows seemed to follow you）、氛围营造、留白——不解释反而更有力。

quizzes.readingPassage: Listen to this short passage. 'The old house stood at the end of the lane, silent and watchful, as it had for a hundred years. Its windows, dark and empty, seemed to follow you as you passed. The villagers said nothing lived there now — nothing, at least, that they cared to name. But on winter nights, when the wind was still, a single light would sometimes appear in the highest window, and then, just as quickly, be gone.' Notice how the writer creates a feeling of mystery without ever explaining what is really there.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 听这一小段文字：「那座老屋伫立在小巷尽头，沉默而警觉，一如它百年来的模样。它那一扇扇黑洞洞、空荡荡的窗户，似乎在你经过时目送着你。村民说如今那里什么都不住了——至少，没有他们愿意说出名字的东西。可在冬夜，风止之时，最高的那扇窗里有时会亮起一盏孤灯，随即，又同样迅速地熄灭。」注意作者如何在从不解释的情况下营造神秘感。

readingQuestions.question: What kind of text is this?
What feeling does the writer create?
Does the writer explain the light?

quizzes.title: 听写：A nuanced argument

subjects.display: One could argue that the opposite is true.
subjects.english: 有人可能会说恰恰相反。

subjects.display: It is not so much a problem as a symptom.
subjects.english: 与其说这是问题，不如说是症状。

subjects.display: Had we acted sooner, this might have been avoided.
subjects.english: 要是我们早点行动，也许本可避免。

subjects.display: The evidence is, to put it mildly, unconvincing.
subjects.english: 委婉地说，这些证据缺乏说服力。

subjects.display: What matters is not what we say, but what we do.
subjects.english: 重要的不是我们说什么，而是做什么。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 听句子并打出来。注意委婉、倒装、强调句等细腻结构。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 细腻结构（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 写出 not so much…as…、Had we…、to put it mildly、What matters is…。

quizzes.title: 阅读：A book review with irony
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一篇带反讽的书评。留意「明褒暗贬」的手法。

helpMemoryTips.title: 明褒暗贬（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'towering achievement' → 转为吐槽篇幅；'something shorter' 是含蓄的贬评。识别反语与低调陈述。

quizzes.readingPassage: Mr Pinter's new novel, we are told, is a 'towering achievement'. It is certainly towering in length: at nine hundred pages, it could comfortably serve as a doorstop. The plot, such as it is, follows a middle-aged professor who spends the entire book deciding whether or not to buy a new hat. Along the way, we are treated to forty pages on the history of felt. Admirers will call this 'meditative'; the rest of us may call it something shorter. And yet — I confess — I read to the end. Perhaps, buried beneath the endless description, there is a real story struggling to get out. Or perhaps I simply wanted to know about the hat.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 据说，Pinter 先生的新小说是一部「巍峨的杰作」。它在篇幅上确实巍峨：九百页，完全可以当门挡用。至于情节——如果那也算情节的话——讲的是一位中年教授用整本书来纠结要不要买一顶新帽子。一路上，我们还「有幸」读到四十页关于毡子历史的内容。仰慕者会称之为「冥想式」；我们其余人也许会用一个更短的词来形容。然而——我承认——我读到了最后。也许，在无尽的描写之下，真有一个故事在挣扎着想冒出来。又或者，我只是想知道那顶帽子到底怎样了。

readingQuestions.question: What is the reviewer's real opinion?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 评论者真正的看法是什么？

readingQuestions.question: What is the joke about the book's length?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 关于篇幅的玩笑是什么？

readingQuestions.question: Does the reviewer finish the book?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 评论者读完这本书了吗？

quizzes.title: 高级语篇衔接

subjects.display: 这一点，再加上前述，解释了失败。
出于这个原因，我们停了下来。

sentences.sentence: 这一点，再加上前述，解释了失败。 → This, ____ with the above, explains the failure.
sentences.english: 这一点，再加上前述，解释了失败。
sentences.referenceExample: This, **coupled** with the above, explains the failure.

sentences.sentence: 出于这个原因，我们停了下来。 → For this ____, we stopped.
sentences.english: 出于这个原因，我们停了下来。

sentences.sentence: 话虽如此，仍有希望。 → That ____, there is still hope.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用衔接短语把段落织成整体，让论述层层推进。

helpMemoryTips.title: 衔接手段（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: coupled with、that said、as noted、for this reason、in sum——高级语篇的黏合剂。

quizzes.title: 修辞手法

subjects.display: 我来了，我看见了，我征服了。
问题不是要不要，而是何时。

sentences.sentence: 我来了，我看见了，我征服了。 → I came, I saw, I ____.
sentences.english: 我来了，我看见了，我征服了。

sentences.sentence: 这可不是小事。 → This is ____ small matter.
问题不是要不要，而是何时。 → The question is not ____, but when.
sentences.english: 问题不是要不要，而是何时。
sentences.referenceExample: The question is not **whether**, but when.

sentences.sentence: 要么现在，要么永不。 → It is now or ____.
不自由，毋宁死。 → Give me liberty, or give me ____.
sentences.referenceExample: Give me liberty, or give me **death**.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 排比、对偶、低调陈述等修辞让语言更有感染力。

helpMemoryTips.title: 修辞（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 排比（I came, I saw, I conquered）、低调陈述（no small matter = 大事）、对比。

quizzes.title: 细腻的条件与反事实

subjects.display: 即便当时更努力，结果也可能一样。
要不是因为他，我们早失败了。
除非另有说明，规则照旧。
就算给我一百万我也不干。

sentences.sentence: 即便当时更努力，结果也可能一样。 → Even had we tried harder, the result ____ have been the same.
sentences.english: 即便当时更努力，结果也可能一样。
sentences.referenceExample: Even had we tried harder, the result **might** have been the same.

sentences.sentence: 要不是因为他，我们早失败了。 → Were it not for him, we would have ____.
sentences.english: 要不是因为他，我们早失败了。
sentences.referenceExample: Were it not for him, we would have **failed**.

sentences.sentence: 假如历史稍有不同…… → Had history been ____ different, ...
除非另有说明，规则照旧。 → Unless ____ otherwise, the rules apply.
sentences.english: 除非另有说明，规则照旧。

sentences.sentence: 就算给我一百万我也不干。 → I wouldn't do it, not ____ for a million.
sentences.english: 就算给我一百万我也不干。
sentences.referenceExample: I wouldn't do it, not **even** for a million.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用倒装、even、were it not for、unless 等表达最细腻的假设。

helpMemoryTips.title: 高级条件（Z28）
helpMemoryTips.text: Even had we…、Were it not for…、Had… been…、Unless stated otherwise。

quizzes.title: 开口说：发表一场演讲

subjects.display: Friends, today we stand at a crossroads.
subjects.english: 各位，今天我们站在十字路口。

subjects.display: We cannot, and we will not, back down.
subjects.english: 我们不能，也绝不会退缩。

subjects.display: This is the duty of our generation.
subjects.english: 这是我们这一代的责任。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 用排比、停顿和坚定的语调打动听众。听并跟读。

helpMemoryTips.title: 演讲的力量（Z9）
helpMemoryTips.text: 排比、留白、直呼听众、有力的结语——让语言产生感染力。

quizzes.title: 习语、隐喻与文化典故

subjects.display: 谁都不愿谈的那个大问题

sentences.sentence: 这是一把双刃剑。 → It's a double-edged ____.
谁都不愿谈的那个大问题 → the elephant in the ____
sentences.english: 谁都不愿谈的那个大问题

sentences.sentence: 因祸得福 → a blessing in ____
冰山一角 → the tip of the ____
泄露了秘密 → to let the cat out of the ____
sentences.referenceExample: to let the cat out of the **bag**

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 隐喻和习语承载文化。地道使用能让表达生动而精准。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 文化的结晶（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: a double-edged sword（双刃剑）、the elephant in the room（谁都不愿谈的问题）、a blessing in disguise（因祸得福）。

quizzes.title: 语气与分寸的掌控

sentences.sentence: 庄重宣布（讣告语气） → It is with deep regret that we ____ ...
sentences.referenceExample: It is with deep regret that we **announce** ...

sentences.sentence: 轻松打趣 → Well, that could have gone ____!
外交辞令 → We have agreed to ____.
含蓄批评 → The report leaves something to be ____.
sentences.referenceExample: The report leaves something to be **desired**.

sentences.sentence: 真诚感谢 → Words cannot ____ my gratitude.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 讣告的庄重、打趣的轻松、外交的含蓄——高级表达在于分寸。

helpMemoryTips.title: 分寸（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 不同场合选择恰当的语气：庄重、含蓄、真诚或调侃，都靠固定表达来实现。

quizzes.title: 听力：A current-affairs debate
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意双方的修辞和论证。

helpMemoryTips.title: 辩论修辞（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'a slow poison'（隐喻）；'give a voice to the voiceless'（对比排比）；正反论点均衡。

quizzes.readingPassage: Tonight's motion: 'This house believes that social media does more harm than good.' Speaking for the motion: 'We have created a world in which teenagers compare their real lives to the edited highlights of others, and then wonder why they feel inadequate. That is not connection; it is a slow poison.' And against: 'Every new technology has been feared. Social media has given a voice to the voiceless and toppled dictators. To blame the tool for how some use it is both lazy and dangerous.' A powerful exchange. Now, over to our audience.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 今晚的辩题：「本方认为社交媒体弊大于利。」正方发言：「我们造就了这样一个世界：青少年拿自己真实的生活去和别人经过修饰的高光片段比较，然后纳闷自己为何感到不如人。那不是连接，而是一种慢性毒药。」反方：「每一项新技术都曾被恐惧。社交媒体给了无声者以声音，也曾推翻独裁者。因为有些人的滥用就去责怪工具本身，既懒惰又危险。」精彩的交锋。现在，交给现场观众。

readingQuestions.question: What is the debate motion?
options: Social media does more harm than good

quizzes.title: 阅读：A journalistic analysis
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一篇分析性新闻评论。留意数据背后的批判视角。

helpMemoryTips.title: 分析性写作（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'Look closer, however'（转折）；委婉限定（rarely the whole truth）；'The real question is…'（强调句）。

quizzes.readingPassage: The numbers, at first glance, tell a reassuring story: unemployment is at a record low. Politicians have, predictably, rushed to take the credit. Look closer, however, and the picture grows murkier. Much of this 'employment' consists of insecure, part-time work, often paying less than a living wage. A person delivering parcels for twelve hours a day, with no sick pay and no guaranteed hours, counts in the statistics as 'employed' — and yet may be poorer than someone officially out of work a decade ago. Statistics, as ever, are not lies; but they are rarely the whole truth. The real question is not how many people are working, but whether that work allows them to live with dignity.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 乍看之下，数字讲述着一个令人安心的故事：失业率处于历史低位。不出所料，政客们争相邀功。然而，凑近一看，图景就变得模糊。许多所谓的「就业」是不稳定的兼职，报酬常常低于维生工资。一个每天送十二小时快递、没有病假、也没有保障工时的人，在统计里算作「就业」——却可能比十年前一个正式失业的人还要穷。数字，一如既往，并非谎言；但它们很少是全部真相。真正的问题不在于有多少人在工作，而在于那份工作能否让他们有尊严地生活。

readingQuestions.question: What do the headline numbers suggest?
What is the writer's real point?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 作者真正的观点是什么？

readingQuestions.question: What does the writer say about statistics?
options: Not lies, but not the whole truth
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 作者怎么看待统计数字？

quizzes.title: 复杂被动与非人称结构

subjects.display: 有人看见他离开了大楼。

sentences.sentence: 据信许多物种已灭绝。 → Many species are believed to have ____ extinct.
sentences.referenceExample: Many species are believed to have **become** extinct.

sentences.sentence: 有人看见他离开了大楼。 → He was seen to ____ the building.
sentences.english: 有人看见他离开了大楼。
sentences.referenceExample: He was seen to **leave** the building.

sentences.sentence: 这件事亟需处理。 → The matter needs ____.
此事正由他人处理。 → The issue is being dealt ____ by someone else.
sentences.referenceExample: The issue is being dealt **with** by someone else.

sentences.sentence: 据估计损失巨大。 → The losses are estimated to be ____.
sentences.referenceExample: The losses are estimated to be **considerable**.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 高级被动包括 be believed to do、be being done、need + V-ing（含被动义）。

helpMemoryTips.title: 高级被动（Z27）
helpMemoryTips.text: be believed/seen to do、be being done（进行被动）、need + V-ing（=need to be done）。

quizzes.title: 精准与简洁（修掉中式英语）

sentences.sentence: 开灯（正确搭配） → turn ____ the light
我非常同意（地道） → I ____ agree
在我看来（简洁） → in my ____
因为下雨（去冗余） → because it ____

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 摆脱中式英语：用地道搭配、去掉冗余、追求准确与简洁。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Chinglish 修复（Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: open the light → turn on；very agree → strongly agree；「因为…的原因」是冗余，去掉一个。

quizzes.title: 开口说：即兴论辩与反驳

subjects.display: I take your point, but consider this ...
subjects.english: 我明白你的意思，但请考虑……
那正好证明了我的观点。

subjects.display: We must draw a distinction here ...
With respect, that simply doesn't hold up.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 即兴反驳要礼貌而坚定，用连接语争取思考时间。听并跟读。

helpMemoryTips.title: 反驳的艺术（Z10）
helpMemoryTips.text: 先承认，再转折，最后立论：I take your point, but… On the contrary…。

quizzes.title: 听力：A literary/critical talk
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 先听，再答题。留意文学评论中的比喻与对偶。

helpMemoryTips.title: 评论修辞（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 对偶（best of times / worst of times）；比喻（leave a door open）；intrigue ≠ confusion 的辨析。

quizzes.readingPassage: What makes a great opening line? Consider the famous first sentence: 'It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.' In just ten words, Dickens captures an entire age of contradiction. A great opening does not merely begin a story; it makes a promise to the reader. It says: trust me, this will be worth your time. Modern writers, under pressure to grab attention, sometimes forget that intrigue is not the same as confusion. The best openings are clear, yet they leave a door slightly open — a question we cannot help but want answered.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 什么造就了精彩的开篇句？想想那句著名的开头：「这是最好的时代，也是最坏的时代。」仅仅十个词，狄更斯就道尽了一个充满矛盾的时代。伟大的开篇不只是开始一个故事，它是对读者的一个承诺，它在说：相信我，这值得你花时间。现代作家在吸引眼球的压力下，有时忘了「引人入胜」不等于「令人困惑」。最好的开篇是清晰的，却留了一道微微敞开的门——一个我们忍不住想知道答案的问题。

readingQuestions.question: What is the talk about?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 这段讲话的主题是什么？

readingQuestions.question: What does a great opening do?
options: Makes a promise to the reader

readingQuestions.question: What mistake do some modern writers make?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 一些现代作家犯了什么错误？

quizzes.title: 听写：A dense editorial

subjects.display: Rarely has a decision been so widely criticised.
subjects.english: 很少有一个决定受到如此广泛的批评。

subjects.display: What is needed is not more talk, but action.
subjects.english: 需要的不是更多空谈，而是行动。

subjects.display: The consequences, though hard to predict, are unlikely to be minor.
subjects.english: 后果虽难预料，但不太可能微不足道。

subjects.display: Were the government to reconsider, much could still be saved.
subjects.english: 倘若政府重新考虑，仍有很多可挽回。

subjects.display: It is precisely this complacency that alarms me.
subjects.english: 正是这种自满让我警觉。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 听句子并打出来。这些句子综合了倒装、强调句、委婉和反事实。

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 综合结构（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 写出 Rarely has…（倒装）、What is needed is…（强调句）、Were the government to…（反事实）。

quizzes.title: 阅读：Analysing a short story
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 读一段关于短篇小说的文学分析。留意「留白」与含蓄的力量。

helpMemoryTips.title: 文学分析（Z31）
helpMemoryTips.text: 被动（nothing is explained, it has been said）；'white space' 的隐喻；含蓄胜过直白。

quizzes.readingPassage: In Hemingway's famous six-word story — 'For sale: baby shoes, never worn' — nothing is explained, and yet everything is felt. The power lies entirely in what is left unsaid. We are not told who is selling the shoes, or why they were never worn; but the reader's imagination fills the silence with loss. This is the essence of great short fiction: it trusts the reader. Rather than describing grief, Hemingway hands us a single object and lets us feel its weight. The best stories, it has been said, are written as much in the white space between the words as in the words themselves.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 在海明威著名的六词小说——「出售：婴儿鞋，从未穿过」——中，什么都没有解释，却什么都感受到了。力量完全在于「没说出口」的部分。我们不知道是谁在卖这双鞋，也不知道它为何从未被穿过；但读者的想象把这段沉默填满了失去。这正是伟大短篇小说的精髓：它信任读者。海明威没有描写悲伤，而是递给我们一件小小的物品，让我们自己去感受它的重量。有人说，最好的故事，写在词与词之间的留白里，不亚于写在词句本身。

readingQuestions.question: What is special about the six-word story?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 这个六词故事特别在哪里？

readingQuestions.question: What does great short fiction do?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 伟大的短篇小说会做什么？

quizzes.title: 阅读：Capstone — A long-form feature
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 毕业级长篇特写。综合运用隐喻、反讽与节奏，读出言外的深意。

helpMemoryTips.title: 特写文风（Z31/Z32）
helpMemoryTips.text: 'sell it by the weekend / by the hour'（对偶）；'screens murmur'（拟人）；含蓄有力的结语。

quizzes.readingPassage: For most of human history, silence was free and abundant. Today, it has become a luxury. In our cities, the hum of traffic never truly stops; in our homes, screens murmur through the night. We have, without quite deciding to, engineered a world in which quiet is something we must actively seek out — and pay for. Wellness retreats sell it by the weekend; noise-cancelling headphones sell it by the hour. Yet the deeper cost may be one we have barely begun to measure. Studies increasingly suggest that constant noise raises stress, disturbs sleep, and erodes our very capacity to think. Perhaps the most radical act of the coming century will not be to speak louder, but to learn, once again, how to be still.
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation: 在人类历史的大部分时间里，寂静是免费而充裕的。今天，它却成了一种奢侈。在城市里，车流的嗡鸣从未真正停止；在家中，屏幕彻夜低语。我们并未真正下过决心，却造出了这样一个世界：安静成了必须主动去寻找——而且要花钱买——的东西。养生营按周出售它，降噪耳机按小时出售它。然而更深的代价，也许是我们才刚刚开始衡量的。越来越多的研究表明，持续的噪音会增加压力、扰乱睡眠，并侵蚀我们思考的能力本身。也许，下一个世纪最激进的举动，不是把话说得更响，而是重新学会——如何安静下来。

readingQuestions.question: What does the writer suggest about noise?
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 作者暗示噪音有什么影响？

readingQuestions.question: What is the writer's closing idea?
options: Learning to be still is radical
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: 作者结尾的观点是什么？

quizzes.title: 开口说：Capstone — 就复杂议题表达观点

subjects.display: On this issue, my position is clear.
subjects.english: 关于这个问题，我的立场很明确。

subjects.display: While there is merit on both sides ...
subjects.english: 虽然双方都有合理之处……

subjects.display: Ultimately, it comes down to what kind of society we want to be.
subjects.english: 归根结底，这关乎我们想成为怎样的社会。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 毕业级口语：综合运用观点框架、让步、证据和有力的结语，完成一次完整的论述。

helpMemoryTips.title: 一次完整的论述（Z9）
helpMemoryTips.text: 立场 → 让步 → 证据 → 结论。用坚定而有分寸的语气收束——这是 C2 的标志。

quizzes.title: The four tones

subjects.english: mā má mǎ mà — mother · hemp · horse · scold
1st tone (high & flat): mā gāo tiān sān
3rd tone (the low dip): mǎ hǎo wǒ nǐ
4th tone (sharp fall "No!"): mà shì qù dà
Neutral tone (the 2nd syllable relaxes): māma xièxie wǒmen
Māma mà mǎ. — Mum scolds the horse. (All one sound, mā-ma-mà-mǎ!)

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: In Mandarin, pitch is part of the word: mā, má, mǎ and mà are four different words. Listen and copy the melody exactly — the tone matters as much as the letters.

helpMemoryTips.title: Tone gestures
helpMemoryTips.text: 1st = sing it flat and high (a doctor's "aaah"). 2nd = rising "huh?". 3rd = a low, skeptical dip ("we-ell…"). 4th = a sharp "No!". Say the gesture, and the tone follows.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Tones are not optional (Z1)
helpMemoryTips.text: English uses pitch for attitude; Mandarin uses it for identity. 买 mǎi = buy, 卖 mài = sell — get the tone wrong and you say the opposite word.

quizzes.title: Pinyin: the tricky letters

subjects.english: q = "ch" + smile: qī qǐng qù — seven, please, go
x = soft "sh" + smile: xièxie xiǎo xī — thanks, small, west
zh/ch/sh = tongue curled back: Zhōngguó chī shì
r = a buzzy r, no lip rounding: rén rè Rìběn
b vs p — the puff of air: bàba pà — dad, fear
ü = say "ee", round your lips: nǚ lǜ qù — woman, green, go

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Pinyin uses the letters you know, but a few carry different sounds. Learn only where pinyin differs from English — the rest is free.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Don't read pinyin as English (Z3)
helpMemoryTips.text: c = "ts" (cats), q = "ch" with a smile, x = soft "sh" with a smile, z = "ds" (kids), zh/ch/sh/r = tongue curled back. "Cài" is tsài, never "kai".

helpMemoryTips.title: b d g: a puff of air, not a voice (Z4)
helpMemoryTips.text: Mandarin b/d/g are gentle, unvoiced p/t/k; p/t/k add a strong puff of air. The contrast is the puff — bā vs pā.

quizzes.title: Greetings & courtesy
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Your first working Chinese: hello, thanks, sorry, goodbye. Type the characters with a pinyin keyboard — or answer in pinyin.

helpMemoryTips.title: Hanzi or pinyin — both count
helpMemoryTips.text: You can type 你好 or "ni hao" (tone marks optional). Long-term, let your pinyin keyboard suggest the characters — choosing the right one is real reading practice.

helpMemoryTips.title: 不客气 answers 谢谢
helpMemoryTips.text: 谢谢 (thanks) → 不客气 (you're welcome). 对不起 (sorry) → 没关系 (no problem). Learn them as ping-pong pairs.

quizzes.title: Pronouns 我 / 你 / 他 / 她
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: The people words. Good news: they never change form — no "I/me/my" gymnastics. 们 turns people-words plural.

helpMemoryTips.title: The 们 plural
helpMemoryTips.text: 我 I → 我们 we; 你 you → 你们 you all; 他 he → 他们 they. 们 works on people only — nouns themselves have no plural at all (Z9).

helpMemoryTips.title: 他 and 她 sound the same
helpMemoryTips.text: Both are tā. In speech, gender comes for free — only writing distinguishes 他 (he) from 她 (she).

quizzes.title: 是 — linking nouns (only!)

sentences.sentence: I am a student. → 我____学生。
He is Chinese. → 他____中国人。
She is my friend. → 她____我的朋友。
I am NOT a teacher. → 我____老师。
They are students. (no plural, no "are"!) → 他们____学生。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 是 shì is "to be" between two nouns: 我是学生 — I am a student. It never changes form (no am/is/are!), and note: no "a/an" needed either.

helpMemoryTips.title: One form, forever
helpMemoryTips.text: 我是, 你是, 他是, 我们是 — all just 是. No conjugation exists in Chinese (Z9). Negate with 不: 我不是老师.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 是 links NOUNS only (Z10 preview)
helpMemoryTips.text: She is tall = 她很高 — no 是! Adjectives work like verbs in Chinese. 是 + adjective (她是高 ✗) is the classic English-speaker error. The next module drills this.

quizzes.title: Numbers 0–99: the Lego system
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Learn ten characters and you can count to 99: eleven is "ten-one" (十一), twenty-two is "two-ten-two" (二十二). It's arithmetic, not memorization.

helpMemoryTips.title: Lego numbers
helpMemoryTips.text: 11 = 十一 (10+1), 20 = 二十 (2×10), 35 = 三十五 (3×10+5). Every number to 99 is built from 一 to 十 — compare English's eleven, twelve, twenty…

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 二 vs 两
helpMemoryTips.text: Counting uses 二 (èr): 一, 二, 三. But "two of something" uses 两 (liǎng): 两百 two hundred, and later 两个人 two people.

quizzes.title: Speaking: introduce yourself

subjects.english: Wǒ jiào Tāngmǔ. — My name is Tom.
Wǒ shì Yīngguó rén. — I'm British.
Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi? — What's your name?
Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ. — Nice to meet you.
Nǐ hǎo ma? — How are you?
Wǒ hěn hǎo, xièxie. — I'm fine, thanks.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Your first conversation — listen and repeat, copying the tones.

helpMemoryTips.title: Copy the melody, not just the sounds
helpMemoryTips.text: Shadow the voice: hum the pitch pattern first, then add the consonants and vowels. Tone is half the word (Z1).

quizzes.title: Questions: 吗 and 呢

sentences.sentence: Are you a student? → 你是学生____？
Is he Chinese? → 他是中国人____？
Is she your friend? → 她是你的朋友____？
sentences.hint: tā shì nǐ de péngyou ma

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: To ask a yes/no question, say the statement and add 吗 — nothing moves, nothing inverts. 呢 bounces a question back: 你呢? — and you?

helpMemoryTips.title: Statement + 吗 = question (Z12)
helpMemoryTips.text: 你是学生。You are a student. → 你是学生吗？Are you a student? No inversion, no "do" — Chinese questions leave the sentence untouched.

helpMemoryTips.title: 呢 = "and…?"
helpMemoryTips.text: 我很好，你呢？ I'm fine — and you? 呢 recycles the whole previous question in one syllable.

quizzes.title: Listening: 你好!
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: The script stays hidden — listen first, then answer. Play it as often as you like.

helpMemoryTips.title: Catch the anchors
helpMemoryTips.text: Listen for 叫 (called), 是…人 (nationality) and 学生 (student) — those three anchors answer everything here.

quizzes.readingPassage: 你好！我叫小美。我是中国人，我是学生。你呢？你叫什么名字？很高兴认识你！
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation:
Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Xiǎoměi. Wǒ shì Zhōngguó rén, wǒ shì xuésheng. Nǐ ne? Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi? Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!

Hello! My name is Xiaomei. I'm Chinese, and I'm a student. And you? What's your name? Nice to meet you!

quizzes.title: Names & countries: 叫 / 姓 / …人

sentences.sentence: My name is Tom. (given name) → 我____汤姆。
My surname is Wang. → 我____王。
I am called Anna. → 我____安娜。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 叫 jiào = to be called (given name), 姓 xìng = to be surnamed. Nationality is country + 人: 中国人 = China-person.

helpMemoryTips.title: Country + 人 = nationality
helpMemoryTips.text: 中国 China → 中国人 Chinese. 英国 Britain → 英国人 British. One pattern, every nationality — no -ish/-ese/-an endings to memorize.

helpMemoryTips.title: Surname first
helpMemoryTips.text: Chinese names put the family name first: 王小美 is Ms. WANG Xiaomei. Teachers are Surname + 老师: 王老师.

quizzes.title: Reading: 我叫汤姆
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Your first Chinese text — meet Tom, the course's hero. Read the characters first; pinyin and English wait behind the info button.

helpMemoryTips.title: Read for shapes you know
helpMemoryTips.text: You already know 我, 是, 人, 好. Anchor on familiar characters and guess the rest from context — that's real Chinese reading.

quizzes.readingPassage: 你好！我叫汤姆，我是英国人。我是学生，我学习中文。我的老师姓王，她是中国人。王老师很好。很高兴认识你！
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation:
Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Tāngmǔ, wǒ shì Yīngguó rén. Wǒ shì xuésheng, wǒ xuéxí Zhōngwén. Wǒ de lǎoshī xìng Wáng, tā shì Zhōngguó rén. Wáng lǎoshī hěn hǎo. Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!

Hello! My name is Tom, and I'm British. I'm a student and I study Chinese. My teacher's surname is Wang; she's Chinese. Teacher Wang is very nice. Nice to meet you!

quizzes.title: Tone pairs & the 你好 rule

subjects.english: hěn hǎo → say "hén hǎo" — very good
wǒ yě hěn hǎo — I'm fine too (a sandhi chain!)

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Real words come in tone pairs — and one pair changes: two 3rd tones in a row can't both dip, so the first one rises. 你好 is really ní hǎo.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Two dips can't dance (Z2)
helpMemoryTips.text: 3rd + 3rd → 2nd + 3rd. 你好 nǐ hǎo → ní hǎo, 很好 hěn hǎo → hén hǎo. Pinyin still writes the original tones — your mouth makes the switch.

helpMemoryTips.title: Drill in pairs
helpMemoryTips.text: Words live as two-syllable teams. Practicing pairs (1+2, 2+4, 3+3…) trains your ear faster than single syllables.

quizzes.title: Characters: your first radicals
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Characters aren't random pictures — they're built from parts. These eight parts (radicals) return inside hundreds of characters as meaning hints.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Meaning left, sound right (Z7)
helpMemoryTips.text: About 80% of characters pair a meaning part with a sound part: 妈 mā = 女 (woman, the meaning) + 马 mǎ (the sound). Learn components, not strokes.

helpMemoryTips.title: Characters compose
helpMemoryTips.text: 好 (good) = 女 woman + 子 child. 明 (bright) = 日 sun + 月 moon. Every character you learn makes the next one cheaper.

quizzes.title: Dictation: first sentences
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Listen and type what you hear. Switch your keyboard to Chinese (pinyin IME): type the pinyin, then pick the right characters — that's exactly how the HSK writing paper works.

helpMemoryTips.title: Type pinyin, pick the character
helpMemoryTips.text: On any phone or computer, add the Chinese (Simplified) pinyin keyboard. Typing "nihao" offers 你好 — choosing the right hanzi IS the writing skill.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Trust the tones you hear
helpMemoryTips.text: The IME shows homophones: typing "shi" offers 是/十/时… Let the tone and context you heard guide the choice.

quizzes.title: Question words 什么 / 谁

sentences.sentence: What's your name? → 你叫____名字？
Who is your teacher? → 你的老师是____？

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 什么 = what, 谁 = who. The question word sits exactly where the answer will sit — nothing moves to the front.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ The question word stays put (Z12)
helpMemoryTips.text: English fronts "what": WHAT do you buy? Chinese keeps it in the answer's slot: 你买**什么**？(you buy WHAT?). Answer: 你买茶 — same shape.

helpMemoryTips.title: Swap-in trick
helpMemoryTips.text: Take the answer sentence and swap the unknown for 什么/谁: 她是我的老师 → 她是**谁**？

quizzes.title: Adjectives take 很, never 是

subjects.display: Chinese tea is good to drink. (tasty)
I am not tired. (不 replaces 很)

sentences.sentence: Chinese tea is good to drink. (tasty) → 中国茶____好喝。
sentences.english: Chinese tea is good to drink. (tasty)

sentences.sentence: My mum is well. → 我妈妈____好。
This book is big. → 这本书____大。
I am not tired. (不 replaces 很) → 我____累。
sentences.english: I am not tired. (不 replaces 很)

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: To say "she is tall", Chinese drops "is" and glues the adjective on with 很: 她很高. Adjectives behave like verbs — they need no copula.

helpMemoryTips.title: 很 is the glue, not "very"
helpMemoryTips.text: Plain 她很高 just means "she's tall" — this 很 is nearly empty. To actually stress it, use 真 (really) or 非常 (extremely).

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ 是 + adjective is the classic error (Z10)
helpMemoryTips.text: 她是高 ✗ — 是 links nouns only. And a bare 她高 sounds like a comparison ("SHE's the tall one"). Default shape: subject + 很 + adjective.

quizzes.title: Family words
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Chinese family words are precise: older and younger siblings get different words. The doubled syllables (妈妈, 爸爸) are easy to say and hear.

helpMemoryTips.title: Older/younger is built in
helpMemoryTips.text: 哥哥 older brother vs 弟弟 younger brother; 姐姐 older sister vs 妹妹 younger sister. There is no plain word for just "brother".

helpMemoryTips.title: The neutral second syllable
helpMemoryTips.text: In 妈妈, 爸爸, 哥哥… the second syllable relaxes to a neutral tone: māma, bàba, gēge.

quizzes.title: Possession with 的

sentences.sentence: the teacher's name → 老师____名字
Whose book is this? → 这是____书？
This is my friend's cat. → 这是我朋友____猫。
sentences.hint: zhè shì wǒ péngyou de māo

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 的 de is the possessive clip: 我的书 = my book, 老师的茶 = the teacher's tea. Close relationships and family often drop it: 我妈妈.

helpMemoryTips.title: Owner + 的 + thing (Z19)
helpMemoryTips.text: Whatever describes a noun comes BEFORE it, clipped on with 的. This little word later carries whole relative clauses — the habit starts here.

helpMemoryTips.title: Family drops 的
helpMemoryTips.text: 我妈妈 (my mum), 我家 (my home), 我朋友 (my friend) — with close people the 的 usually disappears.

quizzes.title: Speaking: my family

subjects.english: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. — There are four of us in my family.
Zhè shì wǒ bàba. — This is my dad.
Wǒ māma shì lǎoshī. — My mum is a teacher.
Wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge. — I have an older brother.
Wǒ méiyǒu mèimei. — I don't have a younger sister.
Wǒmen jiā yǒu yì zhī māo. — Our family has a cat.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Talk about your family — listen and repeat, watching the tones.

helpMemoryTips.title: One breath per sentence
helpMemoryTips.text: These sentences are short on purpose: say each in one relaxed breath, keeping every syllable's tone — speed comes later.

quizzes.title: 有 + the measure word 个

subjects.display: She has three books. (bound things: 本)
I do NOT have a younger sister.
There are four people in my family. (家 + 有)

sentences.sentence: I have an older brother. → 我有一____哥哥。
She has three books. (bound things: 本) → 她有三____书。
sentences.english: She has three books. (bound things: 本)

sentences.sentence: We have a cat. (animals: 只) → 我们有一____猫。
Do you have a phone? → 你____手机吗？
I do NOT have a younger sister. → 我____妹妹。
sentences.english: I do NOT have a younger sister.

sentences.sentence: There are four people in my family. (家 + 有) → 我家____四口人。
sentences.hint: wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén
sentences.english: There are four people in my family. (家 + 有)

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 有 yǒu = to have / there is. And counting anything needs a measure word between the number and the noun: 一**个**人, never 一人.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Every noun brings its suitcase (Z11)
helpMemoryTips.text: Number (or 这/那) + MEASURE WORD + noun, always. 个 gè is the all-purpose suitcase — when in doubt, 个. English already does this with "a CUP of tea, a PAIR of trousers".

helpMemoryTips.title: 有 negates with 没 (Z18)
helpMemoryTips.text: 我有猫 I have a cat → 我**没**有猫 I don't. Never 不有 — 有 is the one verb that refuses 不.

quizzes.title: 这 / 那 / 哪

subjects.display: Which country are you from? (which-country person)

sentences.sentence: This is my teacher. → ____是我的老师。
That is his book. → ____是他的书。
Which country are you from? (which-country person) → 你是____国人？
sentences.english: Which country are you from? (which-country person)

sentences.sentence: Which cup is yours? (cup/glass: 杯) → ____杯是你的？

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 这 zhè = this (near), 那 nà = that (far), 哪 nǎ = which (the question twin). Pointing at things needs the measure word too: 这个, 那本.

helpMemoryTips.title: nà = that, nǎ = which?
helpMemoryTips.text: Same character family, different tone: falling 那 points (that), dipping 哪 asks (which?). The tone IS the grammar here.

helpMemoryTips.title: 这/那 + MW + noun
helpMemoryTips.text: Pointing at a specific thing takes the measure word: 这个人 this person, 那本书 that book — same suitcase rule as numbers (Z11).

quizzes.title: Listening: 我的家
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Listen to Xiaomei describe her family. Catch the counting word 口 and who does what.

helpMemoryTips.title: 口 counts family members
helpMemoryTips.text: Family size uses the measure word 口 (mouth): 五口人 = five mouths to feed. Anywhere else, people take 个.

quizzes.readingPassage: 我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。我爸爸是医生，我妈妈是老师。我哥哥很高，我妹妹很小。我们家有一只猫，它叫花花。我很爱我的家。
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation:
Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén: bàba, māma, gēge, mèimei hé wǒ. Wǒ bàba shì yīshēng, wǒ māma shì lǎoshī. Wǒ gēge hěn gāo, wǒ mèimei hěn xiǎo. Wǒmen jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, tā jiào Huāhua. Wǒ hěn ài wǒ de jiā.

There are five people in my family: dad, mum, my older brother, my younger sister and me. My dad is a doctor, my mum is a teacher. My brother is tall; my little sister is small. Our family has a cat called Huahua. I love my family very much.

readingQuestions.question: 小美家有几口人？
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: How many people are in Xiaomei's family?

quizzes.title: Everyday things
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: The objects around you — several are transparent compounds: 手机 = hand-machine (phone), 电脑 = electric-brain (computer).

helpMemoryTips.title: Compounds are Lego
helpMemoryTips.text: 电 electric: 电脑 electric-brain = computer, 电视 electric-see = TV. Decode the parts and half your vocabulary is free.

quizzes.title: How many? 几 vs 多少

subjects.display: How many people are in your family?
How many books do you have?
How much is it? (how much money)
How many students does your school have? (big number)
How many cats does she have?

sentences.sentence: How many people are in your family? → 你家有____口人？
sentences.hint: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén
sentences.english: How many people are in your family?

sentences.sentence: How many books do you have? → 你有____本书？
sentences.english: How many books do you have?

sentences.sentence: How much is it? (how much money) → ____钱？
sentences.english: How much is it? (how much money)

sentences.sentence: How many students does your school have? (big number) → 你们学校有____学生？
sentences.english: How many students does your school have? (big number)

sentences.sentence: How many cats does she have? → 她有____只猫？
sentences.english: How many cats does she have?

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Two ways to ask "how many": 几 for small countable numbers (expects <10, needs a measure word), 多少 for anything (measure word optional).

helpMemoryTips.title: 几 + MW, 多少 free
helpMemoryTips.text: 几口人? 几本书? — 几 always carries the measure word. 多少钱? 多少人? — 多少 doesn't need one.

helpMemoryTips.title: 几 also tells time
helpMemoryTips.text: 几点? = what time? (literally "how-many o'clock") — coming in the next module.

quizzes.title: Reading: 这是我的家
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Tom introduces his family. Notice 也 (also) sliding in before the verb: 我妈妈**也**是医生.

helpMemoryTips.title: 也 sits before the verb
helpMemoryTips.text: "Too/also" is 也, and it always lands in front of the verb: 她也是学生 — never at the end like English "too".

quizzes.readingPassage: 你好！我叫汤姆。这是我的家。我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。我爸爸是英国人，他是医生。我妈妈也是医生。我姐姐是学生，她很高。我们家有一只狗，它叫Max。我很爱我的家。
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation:
Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Tāngmǔ. Zhè shì wǒ de jiā. Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén: bàba, māma, jiějie hé wǒ. Wǒ bàba shì Yīngguó rén, tā shì yīshēng. Wǒ māma yě shì yīshēng. Wǒ jiějie shì xuésheng, tā hěn gāo. Wǒmen jiā yǒu yì zhī gǒu, tā jiào Max. Wǒ hěn ài wǒ de jiā.

Hello! I'm Tom. This is my family. There are four of us: dad, mum, my older sister and me. My dad is British — he's a doctor. My mum is a doctor too. My sister is a student, and she's tall. We have a dog called Max. I love my family very much.

readingQuestions.question: 汤姆家有几口人？
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: How many people are in Tom's family?

readingQuestions.question: 汤姆的妈妈是做什么的？

quizzes.title: Tones in real words

subjects.english: wǒ hěn hǎo → "wó hén hǎo" — I'm fine
nǐ yě hǎo — you're good too (another chain)
wǒ xiǎng mǎi shuǐ — I want to buy water
jiějie hěn máng — older sister is busy
wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén — five in my family (careful: 五口 stays 3+3→2+3)

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: The sandhi rules from A1.1, now inside real phrases — including chains of third tones. Say them at natural speed.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Sandhi is automatic, pinyin isn't (Z2)
helpMemoryTips.text: Pinyin keeps writing nǐ hǎo with two dips — your mouth converts the first to a rise. Read pinyin with your ears, not your eyes.

helpMemoryTips.title: Keep the last dip low
helpMemoryTips.text: In a 3+3 pair only the FIRST syllable changes. The final third tone stays a low dip — don't lift it.

quizzes.title: Negation with 不

subjects.display: I don't have a dog. (有 takes 没!)

sentences.sentence: I am not busy. → 我____忙。
He is not a doctor. → 他____医生。
She doesn't drink tea. → 她____喝茶。
I don't have a dog. (有 takes 没!) → 我____有狗。
sentences.english: I don't have a dog. (有 takes 没!)

sentences.sentence: That is not my phone. → 那____我的手机。
sentences.hint: nà bú shì wǒ de shǒujī

sentences.sentence: This tea is not hot. → 这杯茶____热。

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: 不 bù makes things negative and sits right before the verb or adjective: 我不忙 — I'm not busy. (Only 有 refuses it and takes 没.)

helpMemoryTips.title: 不 + verb/adjective
helpMemoryTips.text: 不是 is not, 不去 doesn't go, 不忙 not busy. One word, one slot — no "don't/doesn't/isn't" zoo (Z9).

helpMemoryTips.title: 不 changes tone before a 4th tone
helpMemoryTips.text: bù + 4th tone → bú: 不是 bú shì, 不累 bú lèi. Your ear probably does it already — now you know why.

quizzes.title: Colours & describing

sentences.sentence: a red car (red + 的 + car) → 红色____车

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Colours end in 色 sè ("colour"): 红色 red, 蓝色 blue. Describing a noun puts the colour in front with 的: 红色的车.

helpMemoryTips.title: Description before the noun (Z19)
helpMemoryTips.text: 红色**的**车 a red car, 大**的**桌子 the big table — description + 的 + noun, always in that order.

quizzes.title: Dictation: my family

subjects.english: There are four people in my family.

quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Listen and type with your pinyin keyboard. Watch for the measure words 口, 个 and 只 — English ears love to skip them.

helpMemoryTips.title: ⚠️ Don't drop the measure word (Z11)
helpMemoryTips.text: You will hear 一个哥哥, 一只猫, 四口人 — the little word between number and noun is obligatory. Type what you hear, not what English would say.

quizzes.title: Reading: 我的朋友小美
quizzes.helpMemoryIntro: Meet 小美, Tom's friend. Everything here uses this module's grammar: 很 + adjective, 的, 有/没有, and the measure words 个 and 只.

helpMemoryTips.title: 可是 = but
helpMemoryTips.text: The passage ends with 可是 (but) — your first sentence connector. 但是 is its slightly more formal twin.

quizzes.readingPassage: 小美是我的好朋友。她是中国人，她家在北京。小美很高，也很好看。她有一个弟弟，他叫小明。小明很小，他不是学生。小美家有一只白色的猫。我很喜欢小美的猫，可是我没有猫。
quizzes.readingPassageTranslation:
Xiǎoměi shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou. Tā shì Zhōngguó rén, tā jiā zài Běijīng. Xiǎoměi hěn gāo, yě hěn hǎokàn. Tā yǒu yí ge dìdi, tā jiào Xiǎomíng. Xiǎomíng hěn xiǎo, tā bú shì xuésheng. Xiǎoměi jiā yǒu yì zhī báisè de māo. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan Xiǎoměi de māo, kěshì wǒ méiyǒu māo.

Xiaomei is my good friend. She's Chinese and her family lives in Beijing. Xiaomei is tall and also pretty. She has a younger brother called Xiaoming. Xiaoming is little; he's not a student yet. Xiaomei's family has a white cat. I really like Xiaomei's cat — but I don't have a cat.

readingQuestions.question: 小美的弟弟叫什么？
readingQuestions.questionTranslation: What is Xiaomei's younger brother called?
